_comment_file: The SFTP file manager: a remote directory browser, a local side driven by the system file picker, a transfer queue, and the dialogs that create, rename and delete. Almost every value this screen shows comes from a machine the user does not control — file names, owner names, group names, paths — so several strings below tell the reader that a name has been escaped and why. Those sentences are marked SECURITY-CRITICAL and must not be softened into 'this name looks unusual'. Protocol names (SSH, SFTP), POSIX mode strings (drwxr-xr-x) and paths are never translated. RUSSIAN: the vocabulary this file shares with the rest of the catalogue — «панель файлов» for the file pane, «папка» for a folder the user sees in the listing, «каталог» only where errors.json already says каталог, «передача» for a transfer, «очередь» for the queue, «скачать» / «отправить» for the two directions. Every count carries all four forms: one, few, many, other.

header._comment_title: The screen's name. A plural noun, not a verb.
header.title: Файлы
header._comment_on: Names the host the remote pane is browsing. {name} is the connection's own name from the vault, wrapped in a bidi isolate at the call site.
header._comment_close: Puts the pane away again. Only on a pane docked under a session that also has a shell — a file session's own tab is closed by closing the tab, and shows no such control. The word is also the tooltip and the accessible name, so it says what closes rather than only 'Close'.

host._comment_label: The accessible name of the tab area an SFTP session fills, so a screen reader moving between tabs is told which host's files these are. {name} is the connection's own name, wrapped in a bidi isolate at the call site.
host.label: Файлы на «{name}»

pane._comment_opening: While the file pane is being attached. Shown as a spinner's label and read aloud.
pane._comment_openFailed: The heading over the core's failure. The sentence and the suggested actions come from the errors catalogue, keyed by the failure's code.
pane._comment_notConnectedTitle: An SFTP tab that is still connecting, or one whose session has ended. A file pane is a channel on an authenticated connection; before there is one there is nothing to browse, and an empty browser would read as an empty server.
pane.notConnectedBody: Панель файлов откроется, как только это подключение пройдёт аутентификацию. Она работает на этом подключении, а не создаёт второе.

remote._comment_title: The heading of the remote half of the browser. {name} is the connection's name.
remote.title: Удалённый компьютер
remote._comment_tooMany: HONESTY. The core will hand over a folder of a quarter of a million entries rather than pretend it is empty, but the listing is not virtualised yet and drawing that many rows would freeze the window. {shown} is how many are being drawn, {total} how many there are. Do not soften this into 'showing some results' — the number is the point, and so is the way out.
remote.tooMany: В этой папке {total} записей, а Remoter рисует первые {shown}. Сузьте список фильтром, чтобы увидеть остальные.
remote._comment_listFailed: Heading over the core's failure for a directory listing. A listing can fail because the folder is larger than the cap the core enforces; the catalogue sentence for that code names the limit, which is why this heading does not try to.

local._comment_title: The heading of the local half of the browser.
local.title: Этот компьютер
local._comment_noBrowserTitle: SECURITY-ADJACENT HONESTY. This build has no command that lists the local filesystem, so the local pane cannot show a folder's contents the way the remote one does. Saying so is the point: an empty pane with column headings reads as a bug or as an empty disk. Do not soften this into 'coming soon' and do not imply the files are unreadable — the system picker reads them perfectly well.
local.noBrowserTitle: Эта панель не показывает ваши файлы
local.noBrowserBody: У Remoter пока нет команды для чтения ваших собственных каталогов, поэтому локальная сторона работает через системный файловый диалог. Выберите папку, в которую скачивать, или выберите файлы для отправки.
local._comment_folderLabel: The label of the chosen download destination.
local._comment_staged: The heading over files the user picked but has not sent yet. ICU plural.
local.staged: {count, plural, =0 {Ничего не выбрано} one {# файл готов к отправке} few {# файла готовы к отправке} many {# файлов готовы к отправке} other {# файла готовы к отправке}}
local._comment_remove: Removes one file from that list. The accessible name; {name} is a local path.
local._comment_pickerFailed: The system picker refused to open. Every other route into this screen still works, so this is an inconvenience rather than a dead end — but it must be said, because a button that opens nothing reads as broken.
local.pickerFailed: Системный файловый диалог не открылся. Ничего не отправлено и ничего не скачано.
local._comment_chooseFolders: Stages whole folders to send, beside the control that stages files. Two controls rather than one because the platform file dialogs choose files or folders, not either.
local._comment_defaultFolder: Shown under the destination when it is the platform's own downloads folder rather than one anybody chose. 'Remoter picked this for you' and 'you picked this' are different promises, and the pane says which one it is making. The folder works either way.
local.defaultFolder: Предложение Remoter — папка загрузок вашей системы.
local._comment_rememberedFolder: Shown under the destination when it is the folder chosen last. It is remembered for every file pane and across restarts, which is worth saying once so nobody chooses it again out of doubt.
local.rememberedFolder: Запомнена с прошлого раза — для всех файловых панелей.

nav._comment_pathLabel: The accessible name of the editable path field. Paths are never translated.
nav._comment_breadcrumb: The accessible name of the trail of folders above the listing.
nav._comment_atRoot: The title of the control that goes up, when there is nowhere above to go.
nav._comment_back: Retraces the folders this pane has been through, and goes forward again. Words rather than arrow glyphs: the icon set has one arrow per direction and it already means 'go to the folder above', and an icon language stops meaning anything the moment a mark is borrowed for a second job.
nav._comment_noBack: The title of Back when this pane has not been anywhere else yet, and of Forward when it is already at the most recent folder. A disabled control that says nothing is a control the reader has to guess about.
nav._comment_goHint: Under the path field. The field used to refuse anything that did not begin with a slash by disabling its button and saying nothing, so `..` and a bare folder name both looked like a broken control. Both are now sent to the server, which is the only thing that knows what they mean from here. The slash and the two dots are path syntax and are never translated.
nav.goHint: Путь, начинающийся с /, используется как есть; всё остальное отсчитывается от текущей папки. .. поднимает на уровень выше.
nav._comment_keyboardHint: SAID ONCE, UNDER THE LISTING. The listing is a grid and now behaves like one; a keyboard map nobody is told about is a keyboard map nobody uses. The key names are the ones printed on the keys and are translated the way that platform's keyboards label them, never transliterated.
nav.keyboardHint: В списке: стрелки перемещают, Enter открывает, пробел выделяет, Shift расширяет выделение, Ctrl добавляет строку, Backspace поднимает на папку выше, F2 переименовывает, Delete удаляет, а несколько набранных букв переходят к имени.

columns._comment_: The listing's column headings. Each is also a sort control, so each is a short noun.
columns.name: Имя

sort._comment_: Announced on the column header that is currently sorting. 'A to Z' is deliberately about order and not about the alphabet — the collation follows the reader's language, and several languages this ships in do not use A or Z.
sort.ascending: Отсортировано от первого к последнему. Выберите ещё раз, чтобы развернуть порядок.
sort.descending: Отсортировано от последнего к первому. Выберите ещё раз, чтобы развернуть порядок.
sort._comment_foldersFirst: A toggle. Folders above files is what every file manager does, and turning it off is occasionally what a user wants.

filter._comment_label: The accessible name of the box that narrows the listing.
filter.label: Фильтровать эту папку
filter._comment_matches: How much of the folder is showing. ICU plural on the number of rows that matched.
filter.matches: {count, plural, =0 {Совпадений нет} one {# имя из {total}} few {# имени из {total}} many {# имён из {total}} other {# имени из {total}}}
filter.none: Ни одно имя в этой папке не подходит под то, что вы ввели.
filter._comment_note: Explains why filtering here does not fold letters the way search elsewhere in Remoter does. A file name is a string a machine chose; folding it under Turkish rules turns a capital I in a machine name into a letter that is not in it. See docs/features/i18n.md.
filter.note: Имена сопоставляются ровно так, как их написал сервер; единственное, что не учитывается, — регистр букв.

kind._comment_: What a row is. Used as the accessible name of the row's icon, so the reader is told 'folder' rather than hearing nothing.

value._comment_unknown: Stands in for a field the server did not report — a size, a timestamp, an owner. Not 'none' and not a dash: the value exists on the server, it was simply not sent.

risk._comment_: SECURITY-CRITICAL. A file name may carry characters that make it read as something it is not: a right-to-left override can make report.exe draw itself as report.pdf, a control character can cut a row short, a zero-width character can make two different files look identical. Remoter shows such a name escaped, keeps the row visible, and marks it. Do not soften 'disguise' into 'look unusual', and do not imply the file is malicious — it may be perfectly ordinary and simply named strangely.
risk._comment_explain: The tooltip on that badge. {reasons} is a list of the sentences below, joined with Intl.ListFormat.
risk.explain: Это имя показано со скрытыми символами, выписанными явно, чтобы оно не могло выдать файл за что-то другое. {reasons}
risk.bidi: В нём есть символ, разворачивающий направление письма.
risk.invisible: В нём есть символ, не занимающий места.
risk._comment_separatorNote: Shown instead of the row's actions when the name is not a single path component. The core refuses to build a path from it, so there is nothing to offer.
risk.separatorNote: Remoter не станет открывать, перемещать или удалять эту запись: сервер прислал имя, которое не является одним именем файла, — именно так щелчок в одной папке заставляют затронуть другую.

action._comment_download: Verb, imperative: copy the chosen remote entries to this computer.
action._comment_upload: Verb, imperative: copy the chosen local files to the server.
action._comment_selected: How many rows are chosen. ICU plural. RUSSIAN: «элемент» rather than a word for file, because a chosen row may be a folder; the verb changes form with the count and so is inside the plural.
action.selected: {count, plural, =0 {Ничего не выбрано} one {Выбран # элемент} few {Выбрано # элемента} many {Выбрано # элементов} other {Выбрано # элемента}}
action._comment_filesOnly: HONESTY. On the disabled checkbox of a row that is neither a file nor a folder — a socket, a device, a named pipe. Folders *can* be transferred: the core walks one and queues a transfer per file underneath. What cannot be copied is an entry with no contents to copy.
action.filesOnly: Сокеты, устройства и именованные каналы передать нельзя: внутри нечего копировать.
action._comment_properties: The row action that opens the entry's own facts. A noun, because the dialog shows rather than does — the one thing it changes is named on its own button.

drop._comment_: The overlay shown while something is being dragged over a pane.
drop.toRemote: Отпустите здесь, чтобы отправить на сервер
drop._comment_needFolder: Shown instead, when a download is dragged in and no destination folder has been chosen. A drop that silently picked a folder would be a drop that wrote somewhere the user did not choose.
drop._comment_noOsFiles: HONESTY. Dragging a file in from the desktop cannot work here: a browser drop gives Remoter the file's contents, not its path on disk, and the transfer engine sends a path. Say what does work.
drop.noOsFiles: Файлы, перетащенные с рабочего стола, отправить нельзя: Remoter нужен путь к файлу, а перетаскивание его не несёт. Воспользуйтесь кнопкой «Выбрать файлы для отправки».

newFolder.title: Новая папка
newFolder.label: Имя папки
newFolder._comment_in: Says where it will be created. {path} is a remote path, isolated at the call site.

rename._comment_title: {name} is the escaped display form of the entry being renamed.
rename.title: Переименовать {name}
rename.label: Новое имя
rename._comment_escapedWarning: SECURITY-CRITICAL. Shown when the entry's current name carries hidden characters. The field is pre-filled with the escaped form, which is NOT the name on the server — typing over it renames the file to whatever was typed, which is usually what the user wants, but they must know the two differ.
rename.escapedWarning: В нынешнем имени есть скрытые символы, и здесь оно показано выписанным явно. То, что вы введёте, будет использовано ровно так, как введено.

name._comment_: Why a typed name was refused, shown under the field. Each states the rule, not the mechanism.
name._comment_separator: The slash is the path separator on every SFTP server, whatever the server runs on.
name.separator: В имени не может быть косой черты.
name.dots: Имя не может быть одной точкой или двумя точками.
name.control: В имени не может быть управляющих символов.

delete.title: Удалить {name}?
delete._comment_permanent: SECURITY-CRITICAL. There is no trash on the far side and no undo anywhere. Do not soften 'cannot be undone' into a hedge; it is literally true.
delete.permanent: Удаление происходит на самом сервере. Корзины, из которой можно было бы вернуть удалённое, там нет, и отменить это нельзя.
delete._comment_scanning: A recursive delete counts what it is about to remove before it removes anything. This is that count running.
delete._comment_summary: What the removal will take. Two ICU plurals in one sentence, because the counts are independent. RUSSIAN: recast as «Будет удалено: N файлов и N папок», so the passive verb stands before both counts and does not have to agree with either of them.
delete.summary: Будет удалено: {files, plural, one {# файл} few {# файла} many {# файлов} other {# файла}} и {folders, plural, one {# папка} few {# папки} many {# папок} other {# папки}}.
delete._comment_sample: Heading over the first few paths, so the user can recognise what they are pointing at.
delete.more: {count, plural, one {и ещё #} few {и ещё #} many {и ещё #} other {и ещё #}}
delete._comment_truncated: The preview stops at its own limit. It says so rather than implying the count is the whole of it — a removal that turns out to be ten times bigger than the number on the confirmation is the failure this dialog exists to prevent.
delete.truncated: Под этой папкой больше {limit} записей. Число выше — только то, что успели просмотреть; удалено будет всё, что под ней.
delete._comment_links: A real guarantee from the engine, not a reassurance: the walk unlinks a symbolic link rather than descending into it, so a link into a home directory cannot turn a folder delete into a much larger one.
delete.links: Ссылки удаляются, а не раскрываются. То, на что они указывают, остаётся нетронутым.
delete._comment_scanFailed: Heading over the core's failure when the preview itself could not be read. The removal is not offered, because a removal whose extent is unknown is exactly what this dialog refuses to do.
delete.scanFailedNote: Ничего не удалено. Не зная, что там внутри, Remoter не предложит это удалить.
delete._comment_confirm: The confirming button. Names the act, not 'OK'.
delete.confirmTree: Удалить вместе со всем, что внутри
delete._comment_emptyDirHint: Shown when a folder with contents was chosen without the recursive option. SFTP refuses to remove a folder that is not empty, and the core says so by name.
delete.emptyDirHint: Чтобы удалить папку саму по себе, она должна быть пуста.

report._comment_: What the removal actually did. The core reports rather than returning nothing, because a walk that is interrupted leaves the tree half-removed and 'done' would be a lie.
report.complete: Удалено: {files, plural, =0 {ни одного файла} one {# файл} few {# файла} many {# файлов} other {# файла}} и {folders, plural, =0 {ни одной папки} one {# папка} few {# папки} many {# папок} other {# папки}}.
report._comment_partial: Some of it is still there. This is the sentence the report exists for.
report.partial: Часть осталась на месте. Удалено: {files, plural, =0 {ни одного файла} one {# файл} few {# файла} many {# файлов} other {# файла}} и {folders, plural, =0 {ни одной папки} one {# папка} few {# папки} many {# папок} other {# папки}}.
report.limitReached: Оно остановилось на собственном пределе Remoter — на том, сколько всего одно удаление может затронуть.
report._comment_failures: Heading over the list of what could not be removed. Each row carries a path and the sentence for its failure code from the errors catalogue.

queue._comment_: The transfer queue. Every entry has its own progress and its own cancel, and the list outlives leaving the screen — a two-gigabyte copy with no progress cannot be told from a hang.
queue.title: Передачи
queue._comment_active: ICU plural on how many transfers are still moving or waiting.
queue.active: {count, plural, =0 {Ничего не выполняется} one {# выполняется} few {# выполняются} many {# выполняются} other {# выполняется}}
queue.empty: На этой панели ещё ничего не передавалось.
queue._comment_showFinished: A local toggle. Finished entries are kept on purpose so the history of what happened stays readable; this only hides them from view.
queue._comment_directionUpload: Read aloud as the row's first fact, and drawn as a short label.
queue._comment_toLocal: The destination line under a row's name. {path} is escaped and isolated at the call site.
queue._comment_progress: {done} and {total} are byte counts already formatted for the reader's locale. The pair is deliberate: a percentage alone tells you nothing about whether it is worth waiting for.
queue._comment_progressUnknown: The server did not report a size. Common on a growing file and on some servers for every file.
queue.progressUnknown: {done} на данный момент — общий размер не сообщён
queue._comment_retry: Queues a fresh transfer from this one's request. The finished entry stays where it is, so what happened stays readable.
queue._comment_failedTitle: Heading over the core's failure for one transfer.
queue._comment_resumeToggle: The control that asks for an interrupted transfer to be continued rather than started over. Off by default, and the sentence under it says why.
queue._comment_resumeExplain: SECURITY-ADJACENT HONESTY. There is no checksum: SFTP has no standard way to ask a server for one. A resumed transfer trusts that what is already on disk is the beginning of the same file. Do not soften this into 'resume is safe'.
queue.resumeExplain: Продолженная передача исходит из того, что уже лежащее на диске — это начало того же самого файла. Никто этого не проверяет, поэтому оставьте это выключенным, если только вы не знаете, что неполный файл остался от той же самой копии.

resume._comment_: What the transfer decided about continuing, composed here from the facts the core reported rather than printed from the core's own sentence. {offset} is a formatted byte count.
resume._comment_declinedDownloadNotShorter: A resume was asked for and refused. The core refuses more often than a user expects, and a bar that quietly restarted would be a bar that lied. Four sentences rather than one with a placeholder, because 'local' and 'remote' swap places with the direction and several languages inflect around them.
resume.declinedDownloadNotShorter: Начато заново: файл на этом компьютере не короче файла на сервере, поэтому продолжение могло бы его испортить.
resume.declinedUploadNotShorter: Начато заново: файл на сервере не короче файла на этом компьютере, поэтому продолжение могло бы его испортить.
resume.declinedDownloadUnknownSize: Начато заново: сервер не сообщил размер файла, поэтому не было смещения, которому стоило бы доверять.
resume.declinedUploadUnknownSize: Начато заново: размер файла на этом компьютере прочитать не удалось, поэтому не было смещения, которому стоило бы доверять.

queue._comment_enqueueFailed: Heading over the core's failure when a batch was refused. The batch is resolved before any of it is queued, so nothing has started.
queue.enqueueFailedNote: Вся пачка проверялась целиком, прежде чем хоть что-то началось, поэтому ни одна передача не выполняется.
queue._comment_collapse: Rolls the list of transfers away. The panel keeps its heading and its counts when collapsed — a queue that hides how many failed is a queue that hides a failure — and the preference is remembered per pane, because on a laptop the queue takes a third of the pane it shares with the listing.
queue._comment_failedCount: Shown beside the heading, including while the list is rolled up. A failure nobody can see is one they will read as nothing having happened. ICU plural.
queue.failedCount: {count, plural, one {# не удалась} few {# не удались} many {# не удались} other {# не удалось}}
queue._comment_speed: HONEST ESTIMATE. Measured by the interface from the clock the core puts on each transfer, over this attempt rather than over the whole file — a resumed transfer moves at the speed of what it has actually fetched. {rate} is a byte count already formatted for the reader; the unit mark after it is a per-second, not a word.
queue._comment_remainingHours: How much longer, at the measured rate. Rounded to the leading unit on purpose: the difference between four minutes and four minutes twelve seconds is precision the measurement does not have, and a figure that looks precise and is not teaches people to distrust the one beside it. Three keys rather than one with a unit placeholder, because the number and its unit inflect together in several languages.
queue.remainingHours: осталось {hours, plural, one {# час} few {# часа} many {# часов} other {# часа}}
queue.remainingMinutes: осталось {minutes, plural, one {# минута} few {# минуты} many {# минут} other {# минуты}}
queue.remainingSeconds: осталось {seconds, plural, one {# секунда} few {# секунды} many {# секунд} other {# секунды}}
queue._comment_elapsedHours: How long it has been running, or how long it took once it finished. The same three units and the same rounding as the estimate above, for the same reason.
queue.elapsedHours: прошло {hours, plural, one {# час} few {# часа} many {# часов} other {# часа}}
queue.elapsedMinutes: прошло {minutes, plural, one {# минута} few {# минуты} many {# минут} other {# минуты}}
queue.elapsedSeconds: прошло {seconds, plural, one {# секунда} few {# секунды} many {# секунд} other {# секунды}}
queue._comment_stalled: Said in words rather than shown as a speed of zero, because this is the answer the person watching the bar actually needs. It is not a failure: the transfer is still open and may move again, and the threshold is deliberately generous because progress is reported in 512 KiB steps and a slow link is not a stalled one.
queue.stalled: Уже некоторое время ничего не двигается. Передача всё ещё открыта.

transferTo._comment_needFolder: Blocks a download with no destination. A download that chose its own folder would be a download that wrote somewhere the user did not choose.
transferTo.needFolder: Выберите на этом компьютере папку, в которую скачивать.
transferTo._comment_needFiles: Blocks a send with nothing staged.
transferTo.needFiles: Выберите на этом компьютере файлы для отправки.
transferTo._comment_needSelection: Blocks a download with no rows chosen.
transferTo.needSelection: Выберите в удалённой папке то, что нужно скачать.

overwrite._comment_title: DESTRUCTIVE. A transfer writes over whatever is at its destination — an upload truncates the remote file and a download truncates the local one — and there is no trash on either side. ICU plural on how many files already exist at their destinations. The =0 case is reachable: a batch where nothing is known to be there still reaches this dialog when something could not be checked, or when a folder is being merged.
overwrite.title: {count, plural, =0 {Отправить эти файлы?} one {Заменить # файл?} few {Заменить # файла?} many {Заменить # файлов?} other {Заменить # файла?}}
overwrite._comment_permanent: SECURITY-CRITICAL WORDING. There is no trash on the server and none on this side either — a transfer truncates. Do not soften 'written over' into 'updated', and do not soften 'cannot be undone'.
overwrite.permanent: То, что сейчас находится по этим путям, будет перезаписано. Корзины нет ни на одной стороне, и отменить это нельзя.
overwrite._comment_listHeading: Heading over the paths that already have something at them. Each is followed by the size and the date of what is there now, so the reader can tell a stale copy from the one they meant to keep.
overwrite._comment_existing: The facts about the file that is already there, under its path. {size} and {when} are already formatted for the reader, and either may read 'Not reported' when the server did not say.
overwrite._comment_resumeNote: Shown when 'Continue interrupted transfers' is on. The core continues only where the destination is strictly shorter than a source of known size, and starts over everywhere else — so the same batch can both append and truncate, and the dialog says so rather than implying one rule.
overwrite.resumeNote: Продолжение включено. Там, где здешний файл короче копируемого, к нему дописывается остаток; во всех остальных случаях он заменяется.
overwrite._comment_blockedHeading: A destination that is a folder. A transfer cannot replace one, so those requests are dropped from the batch rather than queued to fail one at a time against a server that will refuse each of them. ICU plural.
overwrite.blockedHeading: {count, plural, one {# из них — папка} few {# из них — папки} many {# из них — папки} other {# из них — папки}}:
overwrite.blockedNote: Передача не может заменить папку, поэтому эти элементы не отправляются. В них ничего не меняется.
overwrite._comment_uncheckedHeading: A destination Remoter could not look at. 'Nothing is there' and 'nobody could look' are different answers and must not be shown as the same one. These are still sent: a destination nobody could inspect is a reason not to claim anything about it, not a reason to refuse the transfer. ICU plural.
overwrite.uncheckedHeading: {count, plural, one {# не удалось проверить} few {# не удалось проверить} many {# не удалось проверить} other {# не удалось проверить}}:
overwrite.uncheckedNote: Remoter не смог выяснить, существуют ли они уже. Они всё равно будут отправлены, и то, что находится по этим путям, будет заменено.
overwrite._comment_sending: The last line before the buttons: what pressing the confirming button actually queues, after the folders have been dropped from the batch. ICU plural.
overwrite.sending: {count, plural, =0 {Ничего не будет отправлено.} one {Начнётся # передача.} few {Начнутся # передачи.} many {Начнутся # передач.} other {Начнутся # передачи.}}
overwrite._comment_confirm: The confirming button. Names the act, never 'OK'. This general form is used when the batch replaces nothing, or when it mixes both directions; the two below name which side loses the file and are used whenever the batch goes one way. ICU plural.
overwrite.confirm: {count, plural, =0 {Всё равно отправить} one {Заменить} few {Заменить} many {Заменить} other {Заменить}}
overwrite.confirmDownload: {count, plural, one {Заменить файл на этом компьютере} few {Заменить # файла на этом компьютере} many {Заменить # файлов на этом компьютере} other {Заменить # файла на этом компьютере}}
overwrite.confirmUpload: {count, plural, one {Заменить файл на сервере} few {Заменить # файла на сервере} many {Заменить # файлов на сервере} other {Заменить # файла на сервере}}
overwrite._comment_folderHeading: A source that is a folder. It expands into one transfer per file underneath it and merges into whatever is at the destination, which is neither 'this file will be replaced' nor 'nothing is there'. ICU plural.
overwrite.folderHeading: {count, plural, one {# из них — папка, она будет объединена} few {# из них — папки, они будут объединены} many {# из них — папки, они будут объединены} other {# из них — папки, они будут объединены}}:
overwrite._comment_folderNote: DESTRUCTIVE, in part. A folder transfer does not replace the destination folder; it copies into it, and only the files whose names collide are written over. Do not soften 'written over' into 'updated'.
overwrite.folderNote: Каждая папка копируется внутрь назначения, а не заменяет его. Перезаписываются только те файлы, имена которых там уже есть; всё остальное в назначении остаётся нетронутым.

enqueue._comment_partialTitle: HONESTY. Heading over what a folder transfer would not queue. A transfer that queued 996 of 1000 files has not done what was asked, and a queue showing 996 healthy rows is exactly how that goes unnoticed until somebody needs the other four.
enqueue._comment_limitReached: The folder walk stopped at Remoter's own limit for how many transfers one folder may expand into. It says the count is a floor rather than the whole of it, and points at the way out — taking a subfolder at a time.
enqueue.limitReached: В этой папке больше файлов, чем может охватить одна передача, поэтому обход остановился раньше времени. Найденное поставлено в очередь; чтобы добраться до остального, откройте подпапку и отправьте её отдельно.
enqueue._comment_skipped: Heading over the list of entries a folder walk refused, each with the sentence for its failure code from the errors catalogue. A symbolic link is the common case: the walk does not follow one, because descending a link to / would copy the whole filesystem. ICU plural.
enqueue.skipped: {count, plural, one {# запись не поставлена в очередь} few {# записи не поставлены в очередь} many {# записей не поставлено в очередь} other {# записи не поставлено в очередь}}:

properties._comment_title: The dialog's heading. {name} is the escaped display form of the entry, isolated at the call site.
properties.title: Свойства {name}
properties._comment_reading: While the entry's own metadata is being read. The listing already showed some of these facts; this dialog asks the server again, which is what makes a permission change verifiable.
properties._comment_readFailed: Heading over the core's failure when the fresh read did not come back. The facts from the listing are still shown, so this says which of the two the reader is looking at.
properties.readFailed: Эту запись не удалось перечитать. То, что ниже, взято из списка папки.
properties._comment_path: The row's full path, escaped. Paths are never translated; this is the label beside one.
properties._comment_group: The owning group. Server-supplied text, escaped by the core like every other name here.
properties._comment_linkTarget: Where a symbolic link points, read without following it. Shown only for a link, and beside the facts about what it points at — the two are different questions and the dialog answers both.
properties._comment_permissionsLabel: The editable POSIX mode, in octal. Octal rather than nine checkboxes because the people who use this know 755 and 640, and reaching those through a grid of boxes is slower than typing three digits.
properties._comment_permissionsHint: Under the field. Names the range and says that the symbolic form beside it is the same value, so the two can be checked against each other. The digits and the letters are notation and are never translated.
properties.permissionsHint: До четырёх восьмеричных цифр, например 755 или 4755. Форма рядом — то же значение в записи ls.
properties._comment_invalidMode: Why a typed mode was refused, under the field. States the rule rather than the mechanism.
properties.invalidMode: Это не восьмеричный режим. Используйте до четырёх цифр от 0 до 7.
properties._comment_apply: The button that writes the mode. Names the act, never 'OK'. There is no undo on a server, so it is deliberately not the dialog's default-looking control until the value has actually changed.
properties._comment_applied: After a successful change. The field and the symbolic form beside it are re-read from the server, so this confirms what the reader can already see rather than standing in for it.
properties.applied: Сервер принял новые права, и они прочитаны заново.
properties._comment_applyFailed: Heading over the core's failure when the mode could not be written. Nothing changed; the sentence and the buttons come from the errors catalogue, keyed by the code.
